entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
entry.summary:
At 06:52 am, MetService weather radar detected severe thunderstorms near KAITAIA, AWANUI and MOTUTANGI.
These severe thunderstorms are moving towards the south, and are expected to lie near KAITAIA, HEREKINO and AHIPARA at 07:22 am and near HEREKINO and WHANGAPE at 07:52 am.
These thunderstorms are expected to be accompanied by torrential rain.
Impact:
Torrential rain can cause surface and/or flash flooding about streams, gullies and urban areas, and make driving conditions extremely hazardous.
